MRI Safety Information
MR Conditional (1.5-Tesla and 3.0-Tesla): spatial field gradient ≤ 40 T/m; at 1.5 T: whole body SAR not to exceed 2 W/kg, head SAR ≤ 0.1 W/kg, No more than 20 minutes of active scan time per session; at 3 T: whole-body averaged SAR of 0.1 W/kg or less, Scan for up to 60 minutes, A cooling period of 30 minutes is required between scans; Normal Operating Mode.
Scanning at 7 T has not been evaluated; do not scan at field strengths other than those listed.
